test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Six boys A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6 are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre. A4 is the third to the left of A1. A5 and A3 are neighbours of A4. A6 is to the immediate right of A5. 

Who is sitting third from the left of A6?
solution:
Given: Six boys A1, A2, A3, A4, A5 and A6.

1) A6 is to the immediate right of A5.

2) A5 and A3 are neighbors of A4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f0bfc5450065e33c75070a64ac590dec836773005b3e174cf6226953a377ebd.png] 

3) A4 is the third to the left of A1. 

And, A2 will be placed at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e7ff917f9beac929d4e1248a0fd4b6153752053090a467051ed135799d83005.png] 

So, A3 is sitting third from the left of A6.

Hence, the correct answer is **"A3"**.
